This '''Dractuvian Warrior''' lived on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] of [[Dractu]], and was a member of the [[Sentience/Legends|sentient]] [[Dractuvian]] [[Species/Legends|species]]. Sometime during the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]], this warrior was assigned by his [[Unidentified Dractuvian Chief|chief]] to help a [[Besalisk/Legends|Besalisk]] adventurer named [[Dexter Jettster/Legends|Dexter Jettster]] find some [[Dractuvian cave slug]]s in order to make a meal out of them. Along the way, the warrior helped Dexter out of several dangerous encounters such as large [[Unidentified Dractuvian arachnid|monsters]], quicksand, and an attack from an [[Dractuvian caveworm]]. After Dexter had received his prize, the warrior bid him farewell as Dexter left the planet in his [[Starship/Legends|ship]].
